site.sitedescription:
Grootdrift is located ~15 km inland of the coast, within the Verlorenvlei catchment, west coast South Africa.

Seven sediment cores were extracted from a shore to shore transect across the riverine-lacustrine transition at Grootdrift.
The south bank core, demarcated as GDV1 and two cores derived from within the shallow-waters of the marsh, GDV2 and GDV4 were subsampled for radiocarbon dating and pollen analysis.
